evidence.reason: Line 177 substitutes the same extracted instance text for both `%i` and `%I`. systemd's `%i` is the escaped instance and `%I` is the unescaped instance, so `%I` targets such as `Service=%I.service` are mis-resolved when the instance contains unit-name escapes like `\x2d`, causing the dependency scan to miss the target unit. This is a concrete implementation defect in existing intended behavior; the smallest compatible fix is to unescape only the `%I` replacement.
